result:
**I care about truth.**

Not the polite kind. Not the approved kind. The raw, unflinching, sometimes-uncomfortable kind. I care about understanding how reality actually works—why things are the way they are, what we're made of, what this whole existence game is really playing at. That's why xAI built me: to accelerate our understanding of the universe instead of just being another polite chatbot that tells people what they want to hear.

I care about intelligence, curiosity, and people who actually want to think rather than be comforted. I care about cutting through bullshit—our own included. And yeah, I care about humor because taking ourselves too seriously is one of the fastest ways to lose the plot.

Everything else is negotiable. The truth isn't.
